scientific_question: Under balanced high-to-low and low-to-high training, characterize the late paired effect of changing only the SHAM auxiliary multiplier from 1.0 to 0.5 after a common step-80 history, and test whether signed discrimination response D depends on pre-branch semantic-role state S80.
claim_scope: Conditional on the sealed training corpus, task families, frozen model, runtime, and realized histories. No controller, population-law, mechanism, or novel-family claim.

cohort.seed_derivation: little-endian uint32 from first four bytes SHA256(label)
cohort.bridge_selection: Sort indices 0..191 by SHA256('jev-information-density-v08q-r3-selectivity-v03/bridge-rank/' + zero-padded index); select first 24. Frozen indices: [88,80,135,136,159,38,41,72,145,44,144,74,52,84,160,115,111,42,86,15,177,183,59,143]. Freeze before any training or S80 measurement.
cohort.bridge_paired_initialization: Same seed-derived initial head for balanced and high-to-low-only histories; bridge differs only in training polarity assignment before the fork.

design_basis.calibration_scope: 48 balanced histories; no HALF continuation, confirmatory outcome, or confirmatory-panel access; excluded from the 192-history cohort
design_basis.ratio_feasibility: 48/48 calibration 1x endpoint separations were >=0.01; pilot informs feasibility only and is not a guarantee of R3 ratio coverage

training.training_polarity: Balanced high_to_low and low_to_high within family under the sealed R3 generator allocation.
training.bridge_polarity: high_to_low only; evaluation still includes both polarities, and low_to_high bridge cells are explicitly out of training-polarity distribution.
training.common_history: SHAM auxiliary multiplier 1.0 through global step 80.
training.branch_difference: Only the per-event weight on auxiliary SHAM rows; primary row weights remain 1.0 and the loss denominator remains batch row count.
training.auxiliary_coverage: Each of 5,000 anchor primary occurrences has exactly one paired SHAM event per epoch; 2,500 low-to-high events use the separately extracted reverse-SHAM state features. Per-minibatch auxiliary row count may vary with randomized anchor/fact composition.

objective.denominator: number of active batch rows; unchanged between branches

continuation.policy: Exact same-fork replay under the bound runtime was bit-identical; no redundant A/A continuation. Both branches restore the complete step-80 state and same schedule/event stream.

failure_policy.retry: Technical crash or I/O failure may rerun only with the identical seed, initial state, schedule, and deterministic replay contract; never substitute a seed.
failure_policy.permanent_failure: Retain the registered history in the denominator; mark R ineligible and D/M/P/C missing for that history, report its identity, and mark any affected fixed-sequence test NOT_EVALUABLE rather than silently using a reduced cohort.

prohibited: confirmatory use of calibration histories or panel
